author: Robin_DD_J
body:
Hello people! Some of you may remember me, some of you may not. 
My name is Robin, I used to defend for a team called Bad Company on this server, I was also a moderator at one point and a (very inefficient) map developer. 
  Recently I've got a lot of freetime and thought I'd visit some old communities, just like this one.
  I really just wanted to hop on and say what's up!
  Ask some questions if you'd like.
